title: Battle of Shiojiritoge
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Shiojiritoge", at revision 1370274219, opens: "The 1548 Battle of Shiojiritoge was one of many battles fought by Takeda Shingen in his bid to conquer Japan's Shinano Province." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1076079, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1548 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
